description: eIF4F-dependent initiation on 5'-capped mRNAs, preferentially affecting transcripts with structured 5' UTRs; only partially suppressed by rapalogs because Thr37/Thr46 of 4E-BP1 resist them.

label: Cell growth (mass/size)
description: Increase in cell mass and size driven by the S6K-rpS6 axis and ribosome biogenesis; distinct from proliferation, which depends on the 4E-BP arm.

label: Cell proliferation
description: mTORC1-dependent proliferation controlled by the 4E-BP-eIF4E arm (cyclin D1, c-Myc translation) rather than by S6K-dependent cell growth.

label: Protein synthesis
description: mTORC1-dependent anabolic response of skeletal muscle to loading and to essential amino acids; blocked in humans by acute rapamycin, and the basis of the anabolic-resistance concern in older adults.

label: Ribosome biogenesis
description: Coordinated production of rRNA (Pol I), 5S rRNA and tRNA (Pol III) and ribosomal proteins (Pol II/TOP translation) scaled by mTORC1 and S6K1.

label: adipogenesis
description: Differentiation and lipid-storage programme of adipocytes requiring mTORC1; adipocyte Raptor deletion impairs adipogenesis and reduces fat mass.

label: Autophagic lysosome reformation
description: Tubulation and scission of autolysosomes that regenerates functional lysosomes at the end of an autophagic cycle; it requires mTOR reactivation driven by degradation-derived amino acids [686]. This reactivation is the mechanistic basis of the oscillatory behaviour of mTORC1 activity during prolonged autophagy.

label: autophagy
description: Macroautophagic sequestration and lysosomal degradation of cytoplasmic material; one of the two principal catabolic arms repressed by mTORC1, and the arm with greatest consequence in post-mitotic tissue.

label: cholesterol synthesis
description: SREBP2-driven sterol biosynthetic programme requiring mTOR activity; partially rapamycin-resistant at the transcriptional level.

label: CLEAR gene network
description: Coordinated Lysosomal Expression And Regulation network of approximately 470 lysosomal and autophagy genes driven by TFEB/TFE3 through a palindromic E-box promoter motif.

label: glutamine anaplerosis
description: Replenishment of TCA-cycle intermediates from glutamine-derived alpha-ketoglutarate, supported downstream of mTORC1 by the S6K1-GDH axis and by c-Myc.

label: glutathione synthesis
description: ATF4-dependent production of glutathione downstream of mTORC1, linking growth signalling to redox buffering alongside protein synthesis.

label: glycolysis
description: Glycolytic flux; supported by hepatic mTORC2 via AKT and glucokinase, and required (with glutaminolysis) for effector T-cell metabolic reprogramming.

label: de novo lipogenesis
description: SREBP1-driven fatty-acid synthesis downstream of mTORC1; in liver it is the basis of mTORC1-associated steatosis and of rapalog-associated dyslipidaemia.

label: lysosomal biogenesis
description: TFEB/TFE3-driven expansion of lysosomal number and degradative capacity through the CLEAR network; suppressed by mTORC1.

label: mitochondrial biogenesis
description: Expansion of mitochondrial mass and oxidative capacity supported by 4E-BP-dependent translation of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial mRNAs and by the YY1-PGC-1alpha transcriptional complex.

label: one-carbon/folate metabolism
description: Mitochondrial tetrahydrofolate cycle supplying formyl and methyl units for nucleotide synthesis and methylation reactions; coupled to mTORC1 through ATF4-MTHFD2.

label: pentose phosphate pathway
description: Oxidative branch activated through SREBP-driven G6PD expression; supplies NADPH for reductive biosynthesis and ribose-5-phosphate for nucleotides.

label: de novo purine synthesis
description: Purine nucleotide production driven by mTORC1 through ATF4-dependent control of the mitochondrial tetrahydrofolate cycle.

label: de novo pyrimidine synthesis
description: Pyrimidine nucleotide production stimulated acutely by the S6K1-CAD Ser1859 axis downstream of mTORC1.

label: senescence-associated secretory phenotype
description: Pro-inflammatory secretome of senescent cells, which requires mTORC1-driven translation (IL1A; MAPKAPK2); rapamycin suppresses the SASP without eliminating senescent cells, an example of geroprotective benefit without causal primacy.

label: Actin cytoskeleton
description: Actin filament organisation and polymerisation; the founding mTORC2-dependent output, driven through Rho-family GTPases, PKC isoforms and Tiam1–Rac1.

label: Cell adhesion
description: Cell–matrix and cell–cell adhesion dynamics downstream of PKC and Rho-family signalling, reduced in mTORC2-deficient cells.

label: Cell migration
description: Directed cell motility dependent on cytoskeletal remodelling; impaired when mTORC2-dependent PKC protein and Rho-family signalling are lost.

label: Cell survival signalling
description: Anti-apoptotic programme sustained by AKT phosphorylation of BAD and of FOXO transcription factors; the arm of AKT output most dependent on mTORC2-mediated Ser473 phosphorylation.

label: Epithelial polarity
description: Apicobasal organisation of epithelial sheets, established largely through atypical PKC in the Par3–Par6 module and therefore dependent on mTORC2-mediated PKC maturation.

label: Insulin-stimulated glucose uptake
description: GLUT4-mediated glucose entry into muscle and adipose tissue following insulin; reduced by adipose Rictor deletion and by chronic mTORC2 loss.

label: Distal nephron ion transport
description: Transepithelial sodium, potassium and chloride handling in the distal nephron, set by SGK1-dependent regulation of ENaC, the Na+/K+-ATPase and CLC-K channels.

label: Lipolysis
description: Hydrolysis of stored triacylglycerol in adipocytes. An adipose mTORC2-dependent output alongside insulin-stimulated glucose uptake; adipocyte Rictor deletion alters lipid handling.

label: Late-phase LTP (L-LTP)
description: Protein-synthesis-dependent late phase of hippocampal long-term potentiation and the long-term memory that depends on it; rapamycin-sensitive, whereas early-phase LTP and short-term memory are spared.

label: CNS myelination
description: Formation and maintenance of oligodendrocyte myelin sheaths in the central nervous system. Oligodendrocyte-lineage deletion separates the complexes: Raptor loss causes persistent hypomyelination, Rictor loss has modest and largely transient effects, and only the double mutant impairs oligodendrocyte differentiation.

label: Th2 effector differentiation
description: Differentiation of naive CD4+ T cells into Th2 effector cells. Selectively dependent on Rictor-mTORC2, in contrast to Th1/Th17 differentiation, which depends on Rheb-mTORC1.

label: Foxp3+ regulatory T cell differentiation
description: Differentiation of naive CD4+ T cells into Foxp3+ regulatory T cells. Restrained by both mTOR complexes; loss of mTOR kinase activity promotes it, which is the basis of preferential Treg expansion under rapamycin.

label: Circadian clock (transcription–translation feedback loop)
description: Cell-autonomous ~24 h oscillator built from the CLOCK–BMAL1 activator limb and the PER/CRY repressor limb; entrained centrally by light and peripherally by feeding, and reciprocally coupled to mTORC1.

label: Glutaminolysis
description: Glutamine catabolism supporting anaplerosis; part of the metabolic reprogramming of effector T-cell activation that requires both mTOR complexes.

label: Insulin secretion
description: Glucose-stimulated insulin release from pancreatic beta-cells. Insulin secretion and beta-cell survival are the mTORC2-dependent outputs of the beta-cell; reduced secretion is part of the mechanism of rapamycin-associated NODAT.

label: Ketogenesis
description: Hepatic production of ketone bodies during fasting; a liver mTORC1-dependent output. mTORC1 suppresses fasting ketogenesis via PPARalpha/NCoR1.

label: Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome
description: Autosomal dominant syndrome of fibrofolliculomas, pulmonary cysts with pneumothorax and renal tumours caused by FLCN loss.

label: GATOR1-related focal epilepsy (FFEVF)
description: Familial focal epilepsies caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in DEPDC5, NPRL2 or NPRL3, with elevated SUDEP risk; everolimus titrated to troughs of 5-15 ng/mL gave genotype-dependent, mixed results in small open-label series. Graded emerging, in explicit contrast to established everolimus in TSC.

label: SZT2-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
description: Infantile encephalopathy with epilepsy, intellectual disability, macrocephaly and a dysmorphic corpus callosum, caused by biallelic SZT2 mutations.

label: Age-associated memory impairment
description: Decline in long-term memory with age; reversed in mice and flies by a small molecule that raises mTORC2 activity, which also enhances L-LTP in wild-type animals.

label: Whole-body growth
description: Organismal body size and growth trajectory. Adipose-tissue mTORC2 negatively controls whole-body growth, so adipocyte Rictor deletion increases body size - a direction of effect opposite to the usual anabolic framing of mTOR signalling.

label: Glucose intolerance / insulin resistance
description: Impaired systemic glucose handling arising chiefly from mTORC2 loss: liver-specific Rictor deletion produces a type-2-diabetes-like phenotype, and chronic rapamycin reproduces it pharmacologically.

label: Hypotension
description: Low systemic arterial pressure resulting from impaired distal nephron sodium reabsorption. Reported together with salt wasting on renal mTORC2 loss, downstream of failed SGK1-dependent activation of ENaC, Na+/K+-ATPase and CLC-K.

label: Long-term memory consolidation
description: Persistent memory formation requiring late-phase LTP; selectively impaired by forebrain Rictor deletion while short-term memory is spared.

label: Salt wasting and hypotension
description: Distal-nephron phenotype of renal mTORC2 loss, mediated by failure of SGK1-dependent ENaC and Na+/K+-ATPase regulation; the predicted electrolyte disturbance of mTORC2 inhibition in kidney.

label: Pancreatic β-cell
description: Islet cell type in which both complexes are required; β-cell Rictor deletion causes mild hyperglycaemia with reduced β-cell mass, lower AKT Ser473 phosphorylation and nuclear FOXO1 accumulation.

label: CNS neuron
description: Forebrain neurons in which mTORC2 supports actin-dependent consolidation of long-term memory and spine density; the only tissue where mTORC2 loss produces a cognitive rather than metabolic deficit.

label: Cardiomyocyte
description: Cardiac muscle cell in which mTORC2 is cytoprotective during ischaemia–reperfusion through AKT-dependent anti-apoptotic signalling, so that dual inhibitors are predicted to be more cardiotoxic.

label: Renal tubule (distal nephron)
description: Aldosterone-sensitive distal nephron, where mTORC2–SGK1 signalling governs sodium handling; tubular mTORC2 loss produces salt wasting and hypotension.

label: Skeletal muscle
description: Tissue in which mTORC1 is dominant and mTORC2 largely dispensable: muscle-specific Rictor deletion is close to phenotypically silent while Raptor deletion causes dystrophy.

label: Smith–Kingsmore syndrome
description: Germline gain-of-function MTOR mTORopathy with macrocephaly, intellectual disability and seizures; its phenotype has been extended to include sleep–wake and circadian disturbance, hyperphagia and hyperactivity.

label: Cellular circadian amplitude
description: Amplitude of the cellular circadian oscillation, dampened by pathogenic MTOR variants in Smith-Kingsmore syndrome and improved by low-dose rapamycin in engineered U2OS cells expressing SKS-associated MTOR variants.

label: Circadian behavioural abnormality
description: Disrupted period, phase or consolidation of locomotor rhythms in rodent models of mTOR hyperactivation; rescued by reducing Bmal1 gene dosage, implicating BMAL1 proteostasis as the mediating lesion.

label: Circadian period length
description: Free-running period of molecular and behavioural rhythms; lengthened by mTOR inhibition in SCN explants, fibroblasts and mice [484].

label: Delayed sleep–wake phase disorder
description: Circadian rhythm sleep disorder in which habitual sleep onset and offset are shifted substantially later than conventional times; precipitated in some Smith–Kingsmore patients by high-dose rapamycin.

label: Hyperactivity
description: Recognised feature of Smith–Kingsmore syndrome in the same cohort [361], reported alongside sleep–wake disturbance.

label: Hyperphagia
description: Recognised feature of Smith–Kingsmore syndrome in the 28-individual cohort [361]; mechanistically expected from hypothalamic mTORC1 nutrient sensing.

label: Photic entrainment
description: Light-induced phase shifting and re-entrainment of behavioural rhythms; an mTOR-modulated output [79,484].

label: Premature ageing phenotype
description: Accelerated age-related pathology (cataracts, organ atrophy, shortened lifespan) seen in Bmal1-null mice and attributed in part to unrestrained mTORC1 signalling.

label: Sleep–wake disturbance
description: Disturbed sleep timing, maintenance and quality; a recognised feature of Smith–Kingsmore syndrome and a proposed monitoring endpoint for mTOR-directed therapy.

label: Suprachiasmatic nucleus
description: Hypothalamic master pacemaker; receives retinal photic input, synchronises peripheral clocks, and depends on VIP signalling for network synchrony. mTOR signalling here modulates photic entrainment and central clock function.

label: Alzheimer's disease
description: Target of the autophagy-based mTOR-inhibition rationale; supported by 3xTg-AD mouse data but with no controlled human efficacy data - the ERAP phase IIa study of weekly oral rapamycin uses FDG-PET cerebral glucose metabolism as its primary outcome.

label: Renal angiomyolipoma
description: TSC-associated (or sporadic LAM-associated) renal tumour; EXIST-2 indication, with 42% of everolimus-treated patients achieving at least 50% reduction.

label: HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer
description: Hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer progressing on an aromatase inhibitor; the single disease in which the mTOR, PI3K and AKT nodes have been tested in separate randomised trials.

label: Cancer (advanced solid tumours)
description: Mixed population of advanced solid tumours, 58% carrying pathogenic mTOR-pathway variants, enrolled in the first-in-human bi-steric inhibitor study.

label: Endometrial carcinoma
description: Carcinoma with PIK3CA mutation in roughly 30% and PTEN loss in roughly 35% of cases; site of the complete response to RMC-5552.

label: Focal cortical dysplasia type II
description: Cortical malformation from somatic mosaic activating variants confined to the dysplastic cortex, with drug-resistant focal epilepsy treated surgically.

label: Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis
description: Glomerular scarring produced in mice by podocyte Tsc1 deletion, the upper limb of the podocyte Goldilocks requirement.

label: Glioblastoma
description: PTEN is lost in approximately 40% of glioblastomas, the highest frequency of PTEN loss among these tumour types.

label: Huntington's disease
description: Polyglutamine expansion disorder; mTOR inhibition by rapamycin or the ester analogue CCI-779 (temsirolimus) induces autophagy and reduces polyglutamine toxicity in fly and mouse models.

label: Hemimegalencephaly
description: Hemispheric brain enlargement with severe epilepsy from somatic mosaic activation of MTOR, PIK3CA or AKT3; mTOR inhibition investigational.

label: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis
description: Progressive cystic lung disease driven by TSC2-deficient smooth-muscle-like cells, sporadic or TSC-associated; an approved sirolimus indication.

label: Neuroendocrine tumour
description: Well-differentiated pancreatic, gastrointestinal and lung neuroendocrine tumours; a lineage dependency without a defined pathway lesion, treated with everolimus on RADIANT-3 and RADIANT-4.

label: Parkinson's disease
description: Alpha-synuclein proteinopathy; rapamycin protects against neuron death in in vitro and in vivo models, with autophagic clearance as the proposed mechanism. Preclinical only.

label: Malignant PEComa
description: Malignant PEComa; the nab-sirolimus indication from AMPECT, with response enriched in TSC2-mutant tumours.

label: PTEN hamartoma tumour syndrome
description: Germline PTEN loss spanning Cowden and Bannayan-Riley-Ruvalcaba syndromes, with hamartomas, macrocephaly and elevated breast, thyroid and endometrial cancer risk.

label: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome
description: Germline STK11 (LKB1) loss causing hamartomatous gastrointestinal polyposis, mucocutaneous pigmentation and elevated cancer risk.

label: Polycystic kidney disease
description: Cystic kidney disease in which elevated mTORC1 activity contributes to cyst growth; trials limited by dose-related toxicity rather than absent rationale.

label: PMSE syndrome
description: Polyhydramnios, megalencephaly and symptomatic epilepsy syndrome; autosomal recessive STRADA loss with impaired LKB1-AMPK signalling and mTORC1 hyperactivation; rapamycin reduces seizures (preclinical and small clinical evidence).

label: PIK3CA-related overgrowth spectrum
description: Mosaic somatic PIK3CA activating variants causing segmental overgrowth (CLOVES, megalencephaly-capillary malformation, isolated macrodactyly)

label: Prostate carcinoma
description: PTEN is lost in approximately 30% of prostate cancers.

label: Proteus syndrome
description: Mosaic overgrowth disorder caused by the somatic activating AKT1 E17K variant

label: Renal cell carcinoma
description: Clear-cell renal carcinoma; an approved rapalog indication in which benefit plausibly runs through HIF-dependent translation and the angiogenic programme rather than a cell-autonomous mTORC1 dependency.

label: Subependymal giant cell astrocytoma
description: TSC-associated low-grade glioneuronal tumour; the EXIST-1 indication, with roughly 35% of everolimus-treated patients achieving at least 50% volume reduction versus 0% on placebo.

label: Tuberous sclerosis complex
description: Germline TSC1 or TSC2 loss with somatic second hits producing SEGA, angiomyolipoma, LAM and epilepsy; the indication in which the rapalog mechanistic rationale is fully borne out.

label: Urothelial carcinoma
description: Bladder cancer providing the exceptional-responder evidence for proximal-brake dependency, with TSC1 mutations in roughly 8% of a 109-tumour series.

label: Anabolic resistance
description: Blunted muscle protein synthesis response to amino acids and loading in ageing muscle, with elevated basal signalling and attenuated acute response: a compressed dynamic range.

label: Astrocyte proliferation
description: Reactive astrocytosis accompanying microglial Tsc1 deletion, alongside reduced synapse density and early-onset spontaneous recurrent seizures.

label: Autism-like behaviour
description: Social-interaction and repetitive-behaviour deficits produced by 4E-BP2 loss, demonstrating that excessive as well as deficient translational signalling is deleterious in neurons.

label: Beta-cell dedifferentiation and failure
description: Initial expansion of mass and secretion under chronic mTORC1 hyperactivation followed by dedifferentiation through ER stress and suppressed autophagy.

label: Beta-cell mass and maturation
description: Functional beta-cell number and maturity; impaired by beta-cell Raptor deletion and reduced, with elevated p27, by beta-cell Rictor deletion.

label: Physiological cardiac hypertrophy
description: Adaptive cardiomyocyte growth supported by mTORC1; sustained activity instead contributes to maladaptive remodelling.

label: Cardiomyocyte cytoprotection
description: AKT-dependent anti-apoptotic protection of cardiomyocytes during ischaemia-reperfusion, supplied by mTORC2.

label: CD8 memory T cell quantity and quality
description: Number and functional quality of memory CD8 T cells generated after acute viral infection; enhanced rather than suppressed by low-dose rapamycin, T cell-intrinsically and across species.

label: Cellular senescence
description: Stable cell-cycle arrest with an inflammatory secretome; rapamycin attenuates the consequences of senescence without eliminating senescent cells, so efficacy of an intervention does not establish causal primacy.

label: Cytopenia
description: Anaemia, neutropenia and thrombocytopenia on rapalogs, attributed to the proliferative requirement for mTORC1 in haematopoiesis.

label: Dilated cardiomyopathy
description: Fatal phenotype of complete cardiomyocyte mTOR deletion, marking the lower bound of the cardiac therapeutic window.

label: Fat mass
description: Whole-body adiposity; reduced in adipocyte-specific Raptor-null mice, which are lean with enhanced mitochondrial respiration.

label: Food intake
description: Hypothalamic (arcuate nucleus) control of feeding; intracerebroventricular leucine and leptin suppress food intake through mTORC1, rapamycin abolishes that suppression, and rapamycin partially corrects the hyperphagic obesity of POMC-neuron Tsc1 deletion.

label: Hepatic steatosis
description: Hepatic triglyceride accumulation driven by SREBP1c lipogenesis under hyperinsulinaemia; paradoxically prevented by liver-specific Tsc1 deletion.

label: Hyperphagic obesity
description: Overeating with weight gain produced by Tsc1 deletion in POMC neurons and partially corrected by rapamycin; mechanistically expected in Smith-Kingsmore syndrome.

label: Hypertriglyceridaemia and hypercholesterolaemia
description: Dose-related elevation of triglycerides and cholesterol on mTOR inhibitors, reflecting altered hepatic and adipose lipid handling by both complexes.

label: Immunosenescence
description: Thymic involution, naive repertoire contraction, PD-1+ exhausted-like cells and inflammaging; the most productive clinical testing ground for geroprotection.

label: Peripheral insulin resistance
description: Reduced insulin-stimulated glucose disposal in peripheral tissues. Distinct from direct beta-cell toxicity: chronic mTORC2 loss produces peripheral insulin resistance, and the two mechanisms together account for rapamycin-associated new-onset diabetes at immunosuppressive exposures.

label: Interferon-stimulated antiviral gene expression
description: Upregulation of interferon-stimulated antiviral genes reported with RTB101 plus low-dose everolimus; the mechanistic correlate of the reduced laboratory-confirmed respiratory infections in that phase 2b.

label: Lean tissue mass
description: Fat-free body mass

label: Lifespan extension
description: Increase in median and maximal lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice given encapsulated rapamycin from 600 days of age, reproduced across three sites and dose- and sex-dependent.

label: Maladaptive cardiac remodelling
description: Pathological hypertrophic remodelling driven by sustained mTORC1 activity, distinct from the physiological hypertrophy that mTORC1 also supports; attenuated by partial inhibition in multiple models.

label: Amoeboid phagocytic microglial phenotype
description: Amoeboid, highly proliferative and phagocytic microglial state produced by Tsc1 loss, notably without a pro-inflammatory cytokine signature.

label: Denervation muscle atrophy
description: Loss of myofibre mass after denervation; prevented by constitutively active AKT, establishing sufficiency of the AKT-mTOR arm for maintenance of muscle mass.

label: Muscular dystrophy (Raptor-null)
description: Progressive dystrophy with impaired oxidative capacity and shortened lifespan after muscle-specific Raptor deletion; the phenotype against which near-silent Rictor deletion is contrasted.

label: Load-induced muscle hypertrophy
description: Hypertrophic growth of skeletal muscle in response to IGF-1, mechanical overload or chronic stimulation; mTORC1 is necessary and sufficient and rapamycin blocks it, which is the basis of the anabolic-resistance safety concern for chronic geroprotective dosing.

label: Myelination
description: Formation and thickness of myelin sheaths; requires oligodendrocyte mTORC1, with spinal cord affected more than corpus callosum.

label: Neurodegeneration
description: Progressive neuronal loss with ubiquitin-positive inclusions and motor deficits, produced by neural Atg5 or Atg7 deletion alone.

label: Oligodendrocyte differentiation
description: Maturation of oligodendrocyte precursors; impaired only in the Raptor/Rictor double mutant, indicating that mTORC2 contributes but is not rate-limiting while mTORC1 remains intact.

label: Osteoblast differentiation
description: Bone-forming cell differentiation requiring mTOR signalling.

label: Osteoclast differentiation
description: Bone-resorbing cell differentiation also requiring mTOR, which is why the net skeletal effect of inhibition is context-dependent.

label: PD-1+ CD4 and CD8 T cell fraction
description: Accumulation of PD-1-positive CD4 and CD8 T cells with age; fractions fell in older adults given low-dose everolimus before influenza vaccination.

label: Proteinuria
description: Urinary protein loss on mTOR inhibitors, reflecting the podocyte requirement for mTORC1 and disrupted podocyte autophagic flux.

label: Rapalog sensitivity
description: Tumour responsiveness to allosteric mTORC1 inhibition; predicted by proximal-brake lesions as enrichment rather than individual prediction, and not by distal-network lesions.

label: Sarcopenia
description: Age-related loss of muscle mass and function; the predicted consequence of chronic mTOR inhibition in skeletal muscle, and the central safety question for geroscience dosing.

label: Spontaneous recurrent seizures
description: Epileptic seizures; the shared endpoint of the mTORopathies and of microglial Tsc1 loss, with elevated SUDEP risk in GATOR1 epilepsies.

label: Dendritic spine density
description: Density of dendritic spines, which falls when forebrain mTORC2 activity and Tiam1–Rac1-dependent actin polymerisation are reduced.

label: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy
description: Elevated risk carried by the GATOR1-related familial focal epilepsies, which is part of why mTOR-directed therapy in this group is being pursued on limited evidence.

label: Th1 and Th17 differentiation
description: Effector CD4 lineages requiring Rheb-mTORC1; their suppression is part of the immunosuppressive action of rapalogs.

label: Regulatory T cell expansion
description: Preferential survival and expansion of CD4+CD25+Foxp3+ regulatory T cells under mTOR inhibition, while effector differentiation is blocked; the basis of the immunosuppressive use of rapamycin.

label: T-cell survival signalling
description: AKT-dependent survival output; the second mTORC2-dependent arm in T lymphocytes alongside Th2 differentiation.

label: Influenza vaccine antibody response
description: Placebo-corrected rise in haemagglutination-inhibition titre after influenza vaccination in adults aged 65 and over; the endpoint demonstrating an inverted-U dose-response to mTOR inhibition.

label: Adipose tissue
description: Tissue in which adipocyte Rictor deletion reduces insulin-stimulated glucose uptake, alters ChREBP-driven lipogenesis and lipid handling, and negatively controls whole-body growth.

label: Bone
description: Skeletal tissue; mTOR signalling is required for both osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation, so the net effect of inhibition is context-dependent.

label: Haematopoietic compartment
description: Marrow progenitor compartment whose proliferative mTORC1 requirement accounts for rapalog cytopenias; TSC-mTOR signalling also sets stem-cell quiescence.

label: Hypothalamic arcuate neuron
description: Arcuate neurons in which mTORC1 acts as a nutrient sensor rather than a growth regulator, integrating leucine and leptin into control of food intake.

label: Kidney podocyte
description: Glomerular epithelial cell with a calibrated Goldilocks requirement: both Tsc1 deletion and Raptor deletion produce injury and proteinuria.

label: Liver
description: Tissue in which the two complexes act in opposite directions on glucose output: mTORC1 drives SREBP1c lipogenesis while mTORC2 restrains gluconeogenesis through AKT–FOXO1.

label: Microglia
description: Resident CNS macrophage; Tsc1 deletion restricted to microglia produces an amoeboid proliferative phagocytic phenotype and severe early-onset seizures.

label: Oligodendrocyte
description: Oligodendrocyte-lineage cells of the CNS. Conditional deletion cleanly separates the two complexes: mTORC1 is rate-limiting for myelination, mTORC2 contributes but is not rate-limiting while mTORC1 remains intact. The requirement is regional, spinal cord being affected more than corpus callosum.

label: Oral epithelium
description: Rapidly renewing mucosal epithelium whose mTORC1 dependence accounts for rapalog stomatitis and the dose-limiting mucositis of bi-steric agents.

label: T lymphocyte
description: T lymphocyte compartment. The only tissue in which inhibition of the pathway produces the desired rather than an adverse effect: partial mTORC1 inhibition expands Tregs and enhances CD8 memory, which is the basis of rapalog immunosuppression and of the immune-function geroscience hypothesis.

label: Renal allograft rejection
description: Alloimmune destruction of a transplanted kidney; the first approved indication for sirolimus, given at continuous immunosuppressive exposures with trough monitoring.

label: New-onset diabetes after transplantation
description: Diabetes arising at immunosuppressive mTOR-inhibitor exposures; mechanistically beta-cell toxicity plus mTORC2-dependent peripheral insulin resistance

label: Brain amyloid-beta burden
description: Cerebral amyloid-beta accumulation, reduced by rapamycin in 3xTg-AD mice in an autophagy-dependent manner and largely only when treatment precedes substantial pathology.

label: Renal angiomyolipoma
description: TSC-associated renal tumour; 42% of patients achieved at least 50% reduction on everolimus (EXIST-2).

label: CNS drug exposure
description: Concentration of an mTOR inhibitor achieved in brain relative to blood; restricted and saturable for sirolimus and everolimus, so central and peripheral exposure-response relationships do not coincide.

label: Fatigue
description: Treatment-related fatigue, reported in 42% of patients in the RMC-5552 first-in-human dose-escalation study.

label: Hypercholesterolaemia
description: Elevated plasma cholesterol during mTOR-inhibitor therapy; occurs alongside hypertriglyceridaemia and is attributed to altered hepatic and adipose lipid handling (mTORC2 and mTORC1).

label: Hyperglycaemia
description: Elevated blood glucose on mTOR inhibitors, attributed chiefly to mTORC2 loss (peripheral insulin resistance) with a beta-cell contribution

label: Impaired wound healing
description: Delayed surgical healing and lymphocele formation on mTOR inhibitors, attributed to suppressed angiogenesis and fibroblast proliferation; managed by perioperative interruption.

label: Infection
description: Increased infection risk at immunosuppressive exposures, following from suppression of effector lymphocyte expansion; dose- and schedule-dependent and not seen consistently at low intermittent exposures.

label: Nausea
description: Treatment-related nausea, the second most frequent adverse event (44%) in the RMC-5552 first-in-human dose-escalation study.

label: Non-infectious pneumonitis
description: Non-infectious interstitial lung inflammation in roughly 5-15% of oncology patients receiving everolimus; the most serious and least mechanistically understood rapalog toxicity.

label: Misfolded protein aggregates
description: Aggregation-prone substrates cleared by macroautophagy (alpha-synuclein, polyglutamine-expanded huntingtin), reduced by rapamycin or temsirolimus in fly and mouse models.

label: Respiratory tract infection
description: Respiratory infections in older adults; ascertainment differs between participant-reported events in the phase 2a study and laboratory-confirmed events in phase 2b.

label: Subependymal giant cell astrocytoma
description: TSC-associated brain tumour; approximately 35% of patients achieved at least 50% volume reduction on everolimus versus 0% on placebo (EXIST-1).

label: Stomatitis / mucositis
description: Painful oral ulceration affecting roughly 30-60% of patients on rapalogs and 49% in the RMC-5552 phase 1 study; reflects mTORC1 dependence of renewing oral epithelium and is largely preventable.

label: Clinically symptomatic respiratory illness
description: Self-reported symptomatic respiratory illness; the subjective phase 3 endpoint that RTB101 monotherapy failed to meet in 1024 older adults.
